why: Only known photograph of her: the candidate mugshot beside the Herald preview of the 1997 SGA election, which she contested as sitting vice president. The 1997 Herald scans are 150 dpi, so the frame is small and contrasty; tagged quality.
quality: soft, 150 dpi newsprint scan, small frame
